scripts.allure:archive: if [ -d allure-report ]; then mkdir -p allure-archive && cp -r allure-report "allure-archive/$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S')" && echo 'Report archived to allure-archive/'; fi
scripts.allure:archive:clean: rm -rf allure-archive && echo 'All archived reports deleted'
scripts.allure:archive:list: ls -1 allure-archive 2>/dev/null && echo "--- $(ls allure-archive 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') archive(s) found" || echo 'No archives found'
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:all: (npm run wdio:ui; npm run wdio:api; npm run allure:report)
scripts.test:ui:fresh: npm run allure:clean && (npm run wdio:ui; npm run allure:report)
scripts.test:smoke:fresh: npm run allure:clean && (npm run wdio:smoke; npm run allure:report)
scripts.test:api:fresh: npm run allure:clean && (npm run wdio:api; npm run allure:report)
scripts.test:all:fresh: npm run allure:clean && (npm run wdio:ui; npm run wdio:api; npm run allure:report)
scripts.test:android:fresh: npm run allure:clean && (npm run wdio:android; npm run allure:report)
scripts.test:ios:fresh: npm run allure:clean && (npm run wdio:ios; npm run allure:report)
scripts.ci:test: npm run allure:clean && (npm run wdio:smoke; npm run wdio:api:smoke; npm run allure:generate)
